reviews.title: Bad Management
reviews.text: I have used Himalayan airline two times, I had terrible experience with the boarding staffs. they don't have manner to talk to the passengers. its seems like their passengers are nothing for them. they should send their clear guideline to the passengers while they purchase their ticket. Flight schedule changes without thinking passenger's time value. I never Recommend Himalayan airline any people.
reviews.author: Kumar L

reviews.title: Very poor customer service and customer realations.
reviews.text: Himalaya Airlines has not responded to my request for refund for 9 months. I live and work in Kathmandu and booked a flight. Unfortunately, due to illness I had to cancel. I had a certified letter from my doctor and presented this to the staff at the office in Kathmandu but was rudely told they couldn't help me. After repeated attempts to contact the company and even the owner, I have been ignored. There is no process or willingness to assist customers with concerns and requests for help. This is a budget/ charter airlines whose main business is transporting migrants from Kathmandu to other cities for work purposes. They do not attempt to provide services to tourists. Choose another airline.
reviews.author: Sandy J

reviews.title: Unprofessional, unethical and worst ever!
reviews.text: Flew from singapore to KL to catch Himalaya airlines on 21st to ktm. Got an email from airlines saying flight has been moved to 22nd just few hours before the original flight schedule. I was at the airport waiting. How is that even allowed. I came all the way from another country to get the flight. where was i suppose to stay. They do not value importance of people’s time, money and urgency. I ended up buying another ticket with another airline to reach ktm for a meeting. Himalayan airlines did not even send an apology, let alone my refund. Worst ever airline. Unstable schedules. Worst customer service - when i called them, they did not acknowledge the problem i was in, they showed no empathy at all. Pathetic, unprofessional and inhumane!
reviews.author: Robert B

reviews.title: The worst airline I have ever dealt with
reviews.text: After a very long flight I arrived at Dubai and I was expecting my flight to Kathmandu and then from there to Kuala Lumpur would be a breeze and boy I was wrong. The airline screwed me over telling me that I need a Nepalese visa because the airline don’t want to take responsibility in case the flight gets cancelled or delayed Which is completely absurd and I am not even sure if they had valid flight because the flight numbers weren’t showing in the screen. They didn’t even provide me with a document for me to claim from insurance. A trash airline. While the ticket price is tempting but that money is as good as gone. NEVER BUY FROM THIS AIRLINE!!! NEVER Recommend it to your friends!!!

reviews.author: Mnkbsnss

reviews.title: The biggest scam.
reviews.text: There is a saying if you’re not good at Something then you shouldn’t do it at all. I am writing this review while sitting in Kuwait airport because our plane from Himalayan airlines was delayed for 5 hours and they Didn’t even Felt it was needed to inform the airport that they were delaying for five freaking hours .Then the another flights we were going to transit to left without us because they had no clue when we were coming. It’s not just me that we have are more than 130 students coming from Nepal to go to Australia left abandon inside the airplane without anyone telling us what to do just for them to let us know that oh you messed up now we have to find a ticket by ourself and we are on our own. This is the biggest scam I’ve ever seen in my life. Now me and my friends are stuck in this unknown country and they’re saying you have to buy $3000 tickets to go back to Australia or you have to go back to Nepal in 24 hours with none of them are acceptable it’s because some of my friends didn’t Had that big change of money. This irresponsible behavior not caused 5 hours delay but a big scar me and my friends and my families who are worried back in the home. The biggest disappointment was whole time I think they didn’t even try to contact us and apologize to us. They were like oh you know my bad you have to buy another ticket for the trip I already paid for. I’m beyond pissed and I am beyond disappointed of what just happened to me and I think the worst thing that ever happened to Nepal after it’s bad politics is Himalayan airlines ,Who let this happen not once not twice but a lot of times they were bigger victims any before me and many were abandoned like I am . I think it should be banned from getting flights ever again because this torturous treatment should not be faced for anyone not even my enemies. They should kneel down to all victims for trouble that gave then and close down their business.

reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: One of the worst service, Delhi train service is better then Himalayan airlines service, don’t know why the management are not aware about it, worse crew members as they treat all passengers very unprofessional way; never ever travel with Himalayan airlines again.

reviews.title: So unprofessional service
reviews.text: The worst service I have ever got from any airlines ,it was first time I tried himlayan and it was totally waste of my money, very uncomfortable seats ,and they never shared any travel requirements with thier customer as this covid situation where rules are changing every hours ,its airlines soul responsibility to inform thier passengers about the requirements so that they are prepared from early and don't have to disappointed after reaching airport and finishing all pcr requirements, its totally waste of money and when you reschedule ticket 100$ is a huge amount of charge ,I will never choose this airlines again ,this is totally unworthy of money .
reviews.author: Anurag M

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: On April 21st i went hometown by Himalaya and returned back on 24th of August by same flight (both 2 way) . I felt very bad experienced during both flight time. If you ask them for a bottle of water then they will take your empty bottle and they are filling water and giving back same. Yes as a passenger i understood we are facing Corona epidemic , and we are paying much as before correct? but at least they should provide cup of coffee or tea. But no only some snacks like biscuit, reo juice and small packet of Peanut. Crews aslo not polite to the passenger. From deep inside I will not choose Himalaya. Sorry but not sorry.
reviews.author: rajdeep g

reviews.title: Nepal worst Airlines Customer Service, Terrible Experience
reviews.text: Yesterday midnight 7th of August 2021, I was at the Airport having a ticket from Himalaya Airlines. All the required documents were with me already as per the government announcement but as per Himalayan airlines I should have a Hotel Quarantine booking of Nepal even I was vaccinated and I had Vaccine Card, PCR Negative Certificate with me. For this stupidity of those staff, I immediately booked a hotel quarantine for Nepal as well because I had to travel home with an urgent case. Doing all those also made my ticket cancel saying the booking counter is closed. This really made me so disappointed and left me alone in the airport almost I was crying with my all stuff. For Nepal Quarantine, Someone kept asking everyone if you need Nepal quarantine booking I will do it ryt away so same time that guy booked for me but nothing happened I missed my flight i booked another airline in the morning time and went back to my country Nepal with the same document without the required Nepal hotel Quarantine.
reviews.author: Muhammad Sakir Husian

reviews.title: Pathatic Ground Staff
reviews.text: Being an Indian , the only way to travel to Saudi Arabia during the COVID times is to spend 14 days in some other country and than travel to Saudi Arabia after Quarantine i had selected Nepal as my Quarantine destination , my company had booked the flight in Himalaya Airways , on the 6th May i reached the airport after the quarantine , while i was waiting in the queue to collect my boarding pass , i was informed i cannot board the flight as this flight is only for Nepal and Saudi Citizens during the Covid times , i was shocked , why was this information not told while my company booked the Flight as during the booking it would have asked for Passport details , i spoke to the Ground staff but they just said u cannot board the plane , i asked them to show where exactly is it mentioned about Nationality they had no idea , they did not respond at all , I am still shocked at the unprofessional attitude of the ground staff , i lost the ticket and my company lost the money . ONE OF THE WORST AIRLINES
